summary: Confirmed DONE. The standard (node-served) web build writes a .gz sibling for every hashed compressible asset of at least 1 KiB. The Ryco server negotiates Accept-Encoding with per-variant weak ETags, Vary, 304s without Content-Encoding and an identity fallback. The siblings reach the npm package and the desktop stage: dist/client is a plain recursive copy, files=[dist], and no filter strips .gz. index.html now preloads the whole boot chain and the main CSS at document start, so the CSS-then-main.js request chain is gone. Hosted shells use the Hub's own br+gzip precompression (origin/main scripts/build-static-manifest.ts, src/http/staticAssets.ts), so skipping the plugin for hosted-hub builds leaves no gap. Leftovers are cosmetic: brotli is off by default, the extension list is duplicated between build and server, and unhashed vscode-icons SVGs are uncompressed and served no-cache. None of these is a meaningful cost.

evidence.note: createPrecompressedAssetsPlugin (writeBundle, enforce post) gzips hashed compressible assets of at least 1 KiB at level 9 and skips siblings that save less than 10%. .br is opt-in (:48-54).

The plugin runs only for clientMode 'standard'. Hosted builds rely on the Hub, which precompresses br+gzip itself (ryco-hub origin/main scripts/build-static-manifest.ts:119-131, src/http/staticAssets.ts:119-141,271).

staticFileResponse sets Vary for precompressible extensions, stats the accepted siblings concurrently (br preferred, then gzip), sets Content-Encoding and a per-variant ETag (:134-145), and strips Content-Encoding on 304 (:307). Content-Type comes from the original path.
acceptedStaticContentEncodings handles q=0, *, x-gzip and an empty header (identity) correctly.
identityOnly applies only to desktop mode with a loopback Host. Remote LAN/Tailscale clients of a desktop backend still get gzip. Tailscale Serve keeps the inbound Host, so it is not loopback.

fs.copy(apps/web/dist, dist/client) carries the .gz siblings. apps/server/package.json files=[dist] publishes them, and the desktop artifact copies serverDist as-is (scripts/build-desktop-artifact.ts:1302). The icon overrides target only unhashed files that have no siblings.

The server's extension set is a superset of the build's COMPRESSIBLE_EXTENSIONS (precompressAssets.ts:16), so every written sibling is servable. The two lists are maintained separately, with no cross-check test.
Tests cover br/gzip/identity negotiation, the gzip-only build, Vary, 304 revalidation and the desktop identity path (:1596, :1614).

createBootPreloadPlugin injects modulepreload for the boot chunks and a crossorigin style preload for main CSS. The crossorigin mode matches the Vite helper's stylesheet link, so the preload is reused and no second request is made.

Built at 21:45, after the HEAD commit at 21:40. Head preloads boot-*.js (895 KB, 261 KB gz), boot-vendor-*.js (707 KB, 229 KB gz), rolldown-runtime, main-*.js (922 B) and main-*.css (515 KB, 65.5 KB gz). All hashed JS and CSS have .gz siblings: 691 .gz files, 8.3 MB on a 33 MB dist. Only woff2/png and a few low-gain .pfb files lack one.

The 822 B entry loader is still separate, but the document discovers it together with the preloads, so it adds no round trip. The helper still waits for CSS load before it evaluates main, but both are already in flight from document start, and the CSS (65 KB gz) is much smaller than the JS.

fixDefects: No functional defects. Optional nits: (1) Brotli is off by default (apps/web/vite.config.ts:135 createPrecompressedAssetsPlugin()). HTTPS remote clients (Tailscale Serve, reverse proxy) get gzip, which is roughly 10-15% larger than br on about 555 KB of gz boot payload. (2) The build's COMPRESSIBLE_EXTENSIONS (apps/web/src/viteBuild/precompressAssets.ts:16) duplicates packages/shared/src/precompressedAssets.ts:21, and no test enforces the subset relation the shared module's doc requires. (3) Unhashed /vscode-icons/v12.17.0/*.svg (1,122 files, served lazily, mostly under 4 KB, 117 above 4 KB, up to 248 KB) get no siblings and use Cache-Control no-cache although the directory is versioned. (4) Each index.html or SPA-fallback request does one wasted stat for index.html.gz.
implementationSketch: Optional polish only. (a) Flip createPrecompressedAssetsPlugin({ brotli: true }) in apps/web/vite.config.ts if the extra artifact size is acceptable; the server needs no change. (b) Derive the build's COMPRESSIBLE_EXTENSIONS from @ryco/shared/precompressedAssets PRECOMPRESSIBLE_ASSET_EXTENSIONS minus .map, or add a buildPlugins.test.ts assertion that every build extension passes hasPrecompressibleAssetExtension. (c) Optionally give paths under /vscode-icons/v<version>/ immutable caching in resolveStaticCacheControl and include them in precompression (match on the versioned prefix in the writeBundle file walk). Test with a server.test.ts case.
decisionReason: No security, auth or hosted-lifecycle impact. The optional brotli flip is a minor package-size versus bytes-on-wire trade-off that the code comment already reasons about.
